content:
Apple just wrapped up a very busy product launch season, but a new report offers a sneak peek at the 15+ new products coming in 2027.

Here’s what Apple plans to launch in 2027, per Mark Gurman

Yesterday in his Power On newsletter, Mark Gurman offered an update on the development of Apple Glasses, which he says will debut at WWDC 2027.

But Gurman also outlined 15+ other products Apple has coming in 2027. Per Bloomberg:

The company is also preparing a redesigned iPhone Pro lineup, the iPhone Duo 2, iPhone Air 2, and major refreshes to the entry-level iPad, iPad Air and iPad Pro for next year. A major Apple Watch rethink is in the works as well, along with new MacBook Pros with M7, M7 Pro and M7 Max chips, and updated smart home devices, including the tabletop robot. That’s in addition to the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and upgrades to the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air.

Elsewhere in the report, AirPods with cameras are named as another new product for “late 2027.”

In total, then, Apple could launch the following in 2027:

  • Six new iPhone models
  • Three new iPads
  • Three new Macs
  • Three or more wearables (Apple Watch, AirPods, Glasses)
  • Two or more Home products

And this is unlikely to be a comprehensive list. We may get M7 updates to the Mac mini, for example, multiple Apple Watch models, and more.

2026 has been a big year for Apple hardware, but it sounds like 2027 will offer another packed slate of new products.

Which of Apple’s 2027 products are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.
